stack.worktreesDirectory.description: Directory where worktrees are created (relative to the repository root). Can be set for everyone who clones the repo in .stack/config.json; a value set here wins.

stack.defaultBaseBranch.description: Branch new tasks start from, preselected in the New Task form. When this branch does not exist, Stack uses the repository's own main line (the first of main/master/develop it finds, locally or on a remote), and only then the current branch. Can be set for everyone who clones the repo in .stack/config.json; a value set here wins.

stack.setupScript.description: Script to run after creating a task's worktree. Can be set for everyone who clones the repo in .stack/config.json; a value set here wins.

stack.setupInTerminal.description: Run the setup script in a visible terminal you can type into, and start the agent without waiting for it — for setup scripts that ask questions. Off (default): it runs in the background, its output in the Stack output channel, and the agent starts once it has finished. Can be set for everyone who clones the repo in .stack/config.json; a value set here wins.

stack.teardownScript.description: Script to run before deleting a task's worktree. Can be set for everyone who clones the repo in .stack/config.json; a value set here wins.

stack.promptPrefix.description: Text prepended to the first prompt of every agent you launch (new tasks, the control session, waking an idle one) — sent on its own when there is no prompt otherwise. A personal setting, not meant for .stack/config.json: put reminders here that a fresh agent would not otherwise pick up, e.g. which skill to check first.

stack.defaultProvider.description: Primary agent: the one the big launch button on each task card starts. The chevron next to it opens the rest.

stack.notifyOnAttention.description: Show a native OS notification, with a chime on macOS, when an agent finishes or asks for permission while Stack is in the background. Off means no notification and no sound. The sidebar attention badge is always shown regardless.

stack.phpNavigation.description: Go to definition, references and symbols for PHP in the Code tab, with Phpactor. Off: PHP files are shown without navigation, and no index of the base branch is built. Can be set for everyone who clones the repo in .stack/config.json; a value set here wins.

stack.phpIndexDirs.description: Directories (or files) Phpactor indexes, relative to the repository, e.g. lib, www, src. Empty: every top-level directory holding tracked PHP. Can be set for everyone who clones the repo in .stack/config.json; a value set here wins.

stack.phpExcludeDirs.description: Directories never indexed, relative to the repository (vendor, or lib/legacy). .git and the worktrees directory are always left out. A vendor class is still found through Composer's class maps. Can be set for everyone who clones the repo in .stack/config.json; a value set here wins.

stack.phpExtensions.description: File extensions that are PHP, without the dot (php, phtml, inc). Can be set for everyone who clones the repo in .stack/config.json; a value set here wins.

stack.phpAutoloader.description: Composer's autoloader, relative to the worktree (the main checkout's when the worktree has none). Phpactor reads its class maps to find vendor classes. Can be set for everyone who clones the repo in .stack/config.json; a value set here wins.

stack.phpBaseBranch.description: Branch the PHP index is built from, once, in the background; each task then re-indexes only the files it changed. Empty: Default Base Branch. Can be set for everyone who clones the repo in .stack/config.json; a value set here wins.

stack.phpMaxChangedFiles.description: Past this many PHP files differing from the base branch, a task is indexed on its own, in full, instead of from the base's index. Can be set for everyone who clones the repo in .stack/config.json; a value set here wins.

stack.scriptExcludeDirs.description: For JS/TS navigation: directory names never read, anywhere (dist), or paths relative to the repository (apps/legacy). .git and the worktrees directory are always left out. Can be set for everyone who clones the repo in .stack/config.json; a value set here wins.

stack.oxlintConfig.description: The repository's oxlint config for JS/TS diagnostics in the Code tab, relative to the worktree (e.g. .oxlintrc.json). Empty: Stack's own correctness rules. Can be set for everyone who clones the repo in .stack/config.json; a value set here wins.

stack.phpBaseOnStart.description: Build each repository's PHP index of its base branch when stackd starts, in the background and at low priority (a few minutes and ~1 GB of disk for a large repo). Off: the first Code tab opened builds it.

stack.codeIdleMinutes.description: Minutes a language server of the Code tab (Phpactor, oxlint) may go unused before it is stopped to free its memory.

stack.phpactorPath.description: Phpactor: an executable, or a phpactor.phar run with PHP. Empty: phpactor on PATH, else ~/.config/stack/tools/phpactor.phar.

stack.oxlintPath.description: oxlint, for JS/TS diagnostics. Empty: oxlint on PATH, else ~/.config/stack/tools/node_modules/.bin/oxlint.

stack.phpPath.description: The PHP binary, for Phpactor's .phar and php -l.
